title: claim_bridged event payload
$comment: Class: REQUIRES_SPEC_ID. AUTH-BINDING-BRIDGE-001: a non-worktree session acquired a bridge authority binding to the named spec. The state twin is .caws/claims/bridge.json (written in the same lifecycle transaction). Bridge is authority, not scope expansion: the bound spec's scope.in is the admission surface, nothing wider.

session_id.description: The session that acquired the bridge binding.

context_cwd.description: The cwd the bridge was acquired from (diagnostic provenance).
